text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock E after large gains was satisfying, but I should trim based on its outlook and portfolio risk rather than treating a gain as a reason to sell.","I added to Stocks A, B, and C, then bought more Stock B; before adding again, I should check position sizes, diversification, and whether the investment case still holds.","Account value fell in several periods despite some strong gains. I should judge decisions by their long-term risk and rationale, not short-term swings, and keep enough cash for flexibility."]}
